selection_status.scientific_rationale: Because only 2 single-candidate independent interventions were executed (TUM monitor_01 and OpenLORIS person_01), computing candidate-level precision and recall yields arbitrary small-sample artifacts. Joint multi-candidate outcomes (TUM moving persons, D455 relocated objects) cannot be duplicated into candidate-level labels. We report exploratory group-level metrics while declaring independent candidate-level metrics NOT_EVALUABLE.

tum_k1_comparison.audit_verdict: R7 is mathematically and empirically IDENTICAL to R6 at K=1 on TUM. Both rank person_02 as #1 candidate. R7 provides ZERO added value over estimator-state-only selection at K=1.

tum_k3_comparison.mechanism_explanation: R6 ranks strictly by inlier landmark mass: selects person_02 (478 inliers), chair_01 (312 inliers), person_01 (245 inliers). Because chair_01 is static, querying it produces KEEP action and yields no dynamic suppression benefit. R7 weights inliers by velocity/motion: person_02, person_01, person_03. Motion gating prevents wasting queries on static high-inlier furniture, achieving 0.0182m vs 0.0520m.

d455_k5_comparison.mechanism_explanation: R6 selects static structural objects with large inlier counts (door, desk, ceiling fan) -> F1=0.0. R5 selects objects with highest geometric displacement uncertainty (operator, chair_002, chair_003, box_007, door) -> F1=0.75. R7 combines inlier mass with displacement uncertainty, selecting the EXACT SAME 5 objects as R5 -> F1=0.75. R7 provides ZERO added value over geometry uncertainty R5 on D455.

tum_overlap_summary.mechanism_proof: Tight polygon mask of monitor_01 degrades trajectory (-24.8%, 0.3497m -> 0.4365m). Axis-aligned bounding box mask of monitor_01 improves trajectory (+40.91%, 0.3497m -> 0.2067m) purely because in 52/169 frames, the bbox collaterally suppresses dynamic walking humans passing behind it. Direct moving human polygon mask accounts for 94.95% of total localization gain (0.3497m -> 0.0177m). Person_02 and person_04 were masked jointly; single-candidate attribution is not empirically separable.

d455_anchor_summary.scientific_distinction: The 0.5128m figure is an analytical simulation of map corruption if stale relocated object nodes are retained as rigid anchors. The directly measured held-out static anchor residual after relocation resolution is 0.1242m (12.42 cm), against a noise floor of 0.1198m.
